import UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteMemoryPhysicalSafety

/-!
# Actual-source witnesses for the two physical safety premises

The state is Boolean, the observation is constant, and the controller has
one memory and one action. The safe set is the proper, nonempty set {false}.
Every row is certified, so every original deployment row has zero uncertified
occupancy, regardless of the initial state and successor chosen below.

Starting at false and returning false is physically safe at all times.
Returning true instead preserves initial safety but makes actual safety at
time one, hence at all times, have probability zero. Starting at true and
returning false preserves certified transition closure but makes actual
safety at time zero, hence at all times, have probability zero.

The masses are obtained through the proved actual coordinate-law identity.
No event mass, path agreement, or safety conclusion is stipulated as data.
-/

namespace UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure
namespace FiniteMemorySafetyWitness

open MeasureTheory UEOT.V3.PathError SupportViabilityClosure
open FiniteMemoryPhysicalSafety
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

local instance : MeasurableSpace Bool := ⊤

def observe (_x : Bool) : Unit := ()

def controller : FiniteMemoryController Unit Unit Unit where
  initialMemory := fun _ => ()
  action := fun _ => PMF.pure ()
  update := fun _ _ _ => ()

def source (next : Bool) (_n : ℕ) (_x : Bool) (_a : Unit) : PMF Bool :=
  PMF.pure next

def certified (_n : ℕ) (_x : Bool) (_a : Unit) : Prop := True

def safe : Set Bool := {false}

/-- The physical set is proper and nonempty. -/
theorem safe_is_proper_nonempty : safe.Nonempty ∧ safe ≠ Set.univ := by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨false, rfl⟩
  · intro h
    have ht : true ∈ safe := by
      rw [h]
      exact Set.mem_univ true
    change (true : Bool) = false at ht
    cases ht

/-- Zero uncertified occupancy holds in every actual deployment row of
every source in this family, independently of its physical behavior. -/
theorem all_rows_zero_uncovered (initial next : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    (coverageDeploymentRowLaw (PMF.pure initial) observe (source next)
      controller.policy n).toMeasure.real
        {xa | ¬ certified n xa.1 xa.2} = 0 := by
  apply (zero_uncovered_iff_support_certified
    (PMF.pure initial) observe (source next) controller.policy certified n).mpr
  intro _ _ _ _ _ _
  trivial

theorem initial_false_safe :
    ∀ x ∈ (PMF.pure false : PMF Bool).support, x ∈ safe := by
  intro x hx
  simpa only [PMF.support_pure, safe] using hx

/-- Returning false satisfies the actual certified-support closure
independently of the original initial state. -/
theorem source_false_preserves_safe :
    ∀ n x a, x ∈ safe → certified n x a →
      ∀ z ∈ (source false n x a).support, z ∈ safe := by
  intro n x a _ _ z hz
  simpa only [source, PMF.support_pure, safe] using hz

/-- A nonempty actual source with a proper safe set satisfies the positive
physical-safety endpoint, using both physical premises. -/
theorem safe_source_all_times_mass_one :
    stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure false) observe (source false)
      {ω | ∀ n : ℕ, ω n ∈ safe} = 1 := by
  exact controller_all_times_physical_safe controller (PMF.pure false)
    observe (source false) certified safe initial_false_safe
    source_false_preserves_safe (all_rows_zero_uncovered false false)

/-- With the same safe initial state and zero uncertified occupancy,
changing the actual successor to true makes time-one physical safety zero. -/
theorem unsafe_transition_time_one_mass_zero :
    stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure false) observe (source true)
      {ω | ω 1 ∈ safe} = 0 := by
  rw [stateTrajMeasure_coordinate_mass]
  let p : PMF (CausalHistory Bool (Unit × Bool) 1) :=
    microLaw (PMF.pure false) observe (source true) controller.policy 1
  change p.toMeasure {h | riskLastState 1 h ∈ safe} = 0
  apply (p.toMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet).mpr
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro ⟨x, a, z⟩ hh hs
  have hparts := (mem_microLaw_succ_support_iff (PMF.pure false)
    observe (source true) controller.policy 0 x a z).mp hh
  have hz : z = true := by
    simpa only [source, PMF.support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hparts.2.2
  change z = false at hs
  cases hz.symm.trans hs

private theorem all_times_mass_le_coordinate
    (initial next : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure initial) observe (source next)
        {ω | ∀ k : ℕ, ω k ∈ safe} ≤
      stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure initial) observe (source next)
        {ω | ω n ∈ safe} :=
  measure_mono (fun _ h => h n)

/-- Initial physical safety and zero uncertified occupancy do not imply
all-times physical safety without certified transition closure. -/
theorem unsafe_transition_all_times_mass_zero :
    stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure false) observe (source true)
      {ω | ∀ n : ℕ, ω n ∈ safe} = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
  calc
    _ ≤ stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure false) observe (source true)
        {ω | ω 1 ∈ safe} := all_times_mass_le_coordinate false true 1
    _ = 0 := unsafe_transition_time_one_mass_zero

/-- Keeping certified transition closure and zero uncertified occupancy,
an unsafe original initial state gives time-zero physical safety zero. -/
theorem unsafe_initial_time_zero_mass_zero :
    stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure true) observe (source false)
      {ω | ω 0 ∈ safe} = 0 := by
  rw [stateTrajMeasure_coordinate_mass]
  change (PMF.pure true : PMF Bool).toMeasure safe = 0
  apply ((PMF.pure true : PMF Bool).toMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff
    (Set.toFinite safe).measurableSet).mpr
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hs
  have hxtrue : x = true := by
    simpa only [PMF.support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
  change x = false at hs
  cases hxtrue.symm.trans hs

/-- Certified transitions may immediately repair the state, but they do
not erase failure at time zero from the original all-times event. -/
theorem unsafe_initial_all_times_mass_zero :
    stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure true) observe (source false)
      {ω | ∀ n : ℕ, ω n ∈ safe} = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
  calc
    _ ≤ stateTrajMeasure controller (PMF.pure true) observe (source false)
        {ω | ω 0 ∈ safe} := all_times_mass_le_coordinate true false 0
    _ = 0 := unsafe_initial_time_zero_mass_zero

end
end FiniteMemorySafetyWitness
end UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure

import UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceKilledExitFlux

/-!
# Same-source finite-window survival conditioning

The prefix is a complete microscopic state prefix. Its joint mass with survival
to the original horizon is derived from the existing causal PMF recursion.
The initial PMF is never pre-normalized. Every conditional PMF filters the
original action/state experiment, and every matrix is its existing killed
restriction. The normalized row PMF requires strictly positive remaining
survival; no probability distribution is assigned to a null row.
-/

namespace UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck

open MeasureTheory
open UEOT.V3.PathError
open UEOT.V3.FiniteDiscountedControl
open UEOT.V3.CoreOperationalAssembly
open UEOT.V3.QSDPerron
open SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck SameSourceKilledPathCheck
open SameSourceConditionedTerminalCheck
open scoped BigOperators Classical

noncomputable section
universe u

/-- Drop the final r records, retaining the complete prefix through time t. -/
def statePrefix {X : Type u} (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ r, CausalHistory X X (t + r) → CausalHistory X X t
  | 0, h => h
  | r + 1, h => statePrefix t r h.1

private theorem stateSurvives_prefix
    {X : Type u} (K : Set X) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ r (h : CausalHistory X X (t + r)),
      stateSurvives K (t + r) h → stateSurvives K t (statePrefix t r h) := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero => intro h hh; exact hh
  | succ r ih => intro h hh; exact ih h.1 hh.1

/-- The same killed matrix supplies the remaining-survival function. -/
def remainingSurvival {S : Type u} [Fintype S]
    (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) (r : ℕ) (i : S) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : S, (Q ^ r) i j

@[simp] theorem remainingSurvival_zero
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) (i : S) :
    remainingSurvival Q 0 i = 1 := by
  simp [remainingSurvival, Matrix.one_apply]

theorem remainingSurvival_succ
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) (r : ℕ) (i : S) :
    remainingSurvival Q (r + 1) i =
      ∑ j : S, Q i j * remainingSurvival Q r j := by
  simp only [remainingSurvival, pow_succ', Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

theorem remainingSurvival_nonneg
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j) (r : ℕ) (i : S) :
    0 ≤ remainingSurvival Q r i := by
  induction r generalizing i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [remainingSurvival_succ]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hQ i j) (ih j)

/-- Finite path weight for an unnormalized initial row and an arbitrary matrix.
Its probability meaning is supplied by the source theorem below. -/
def matrixPathWeight {S : Type u} (eta : S → ℝ) (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) :
    ∀ n, CausalHistory S S n → ℝ
  | 0, h => eta h
  | n + 1, h => matrixPathWeight eta Q n h.1 * Q (currentState n h.1) h.2

/-- Embed a complete safe-state history in the original state alphabet. -/
def safeHistory {X : Type u} (K : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    CausalHistory K K n → CausalHistory X X n :=
  riskHistoryMap Subtype.val Subtype.val n

private theorem safeHistory_current
    {X : Type u} (K : Set X) (n : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory K K n) :
    currentState n (safeHistory K n h) = (currentState n h).1 := by
  cases n <;> rfl

private theorem safeHistory_survives
    {X : Type u} (K : Set X) :
    ∀ n (h : CausalHistory K K n), stateSurvives K n (safeHistory K n h) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; exact h.property
  | succ n ih => intro h; exact ⟨ih h.1, h.2.property⟩

private theorem sum_safe_subtype
    {X : Type u} [Fintype X] (K : Set X) (f : X → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : X, if x ∈ K then f x else 0) = ∑ x : K, f x.1 := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  exact Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X => x ∈ K))
    (by intro x; simp) f

private theorem finite_event_mass
    {H : Type u} [Fintype H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [MeasurableSingletonClass H]
    (p : PMF H) (E : H → Prop) :
    p.toMeasure.real {h | E h} = ∑ h : H, if E h then (p h).toReal else 0 := by
  have hset : {h | E h} = (Finset.univ.filter E : Set H) := by
    ext h
    simp
  rw [hset, pmfMeasureReal_eq_sum_finset, Finset.sum_filter]

private theorem stateSurvives_erase_iff
    {X A : Type u} (K : Set X) :
    ∀ n (h : CausalHistory X (A × X) n),
      stateSurvives K n (eraseActionHistory n h) ↔
        ¬ riskEverFailure (fun x => x ∉ K) n h := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; change (h ∈ K) ↔ ¬ (h ∉ K); tauto
  | succ n ih =>
      intro h
      change (stateSurvives K n (eraseActionHistory n h.1) ∧ h.2.2 ∈ K) ↔
        ¬ (riskEverFailure (fun x => x ∉ K) n h.1 ∨ h.2.2 ∉ K)
      rw [ih h.1]
      tauto

section StateSource

variable {X A : Type u} [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
variable (M : Model X (fun _ => A)) (pi : StationaryPolicy (fun _ : X => A))
variable (p0 : PMF X) (K : Set X)

local instance : DecidableEq K := Classical.decEq K

private def weightedPrefixMass (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (f : X → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ g : CausalHistory X X (t + r),
    if stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ statePrefix t r g = h then
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) (t + r) g).toReal *
        f (currentState (t + r) g)
    else 0

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem weightedPrefixMass_eq
    (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (hs : stateSurvives K t h) (i : K) (hi : currentState t h = i.1)
    (f : X → ℝ) :
    weightedPrefixMass M pi p0 K t r h f =
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal *
        ∑ j : K, ((killedMatrix M pi K) ^ r) i j * f j.1 := by
  induction r generalizing f with
  | zero =>
      unfold weightedPrefixMass
      change (∑ g : CausalHistory X X t,
        if stateSurvives K t g ∧ g = h then
          (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t g).toReal * f (currentState t g)
        else 0) = _
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single h]
      · simp [hs, hi, Matrix.one_apply]
      · intro g _ hg
        simp [hg]
      · simp
  | succ r ih =>
      let mu := causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) (t + r)
      let F : X → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j : K, policyMatrix M pi x j.1 * f j.1
      have hinner (g : CausalHistory X X (t + r)) :
          (∑ z : X,
            if (stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ z ∈ K) ∧ statePrefix t r g = h then
              (mu g).toReal * (policyPathKernel M pi (t + r) g z).toReal * f z
            else 0) =
          if stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ statePrefix t r g = h then
            (mu g).toReal * F (currentState (t + r) g) else 0 := by
        by_cases hsafe : stateSurvives K (t + r) g
        · by_cases hpre : statePrefix t r g = h
          · simp only [hsafe, hpre, true_and, and_true, if_true]
            calc
              (∑ z : X, if z ∈ K then
                (mu g).toReal * (policyPathKernel M pi (t + r) g z).toReal * f z
                else 0) =
                  (mu g).toReal * ∑ z : X, if z ∈ K then
                    (policyPathKernel M pi (t + r) g z).toReal * f z else 0 := by
                rw [Finset.mul_sum]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro z _
                by_cases hz : z ∈ K <;> simp [hz, mul_assoc]
              _ = (mu g).toReal * F (currentState (t + r) g) := by
                rw [sum_safe_subtype]
                simp only [F, policyPathKernel, policyTransitionPMF_apply_toReal, policyMatrix]
          · simp [hpre]
        · simp [hsafe]
      have hrec :
          weightedPrefixMass M pi p0 K t (r + 1) h f =
            weightedPrefixMass M pi p0 K t r h F := by
        unfold weightedPrefixMass
        change (∑ gz : CausalHistory X X (t + r) × X,
          if stateSurvives K ((t + r) + 1) gz ∧ statePrefix t (r + 1) gz = h then
            (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) ((t + r) + 1) gz).toReal *
              f (currentState ((t + r) + 1) gz)
          else 0) = _
        rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g _
        calc
          _ = (∑ z : X,
              if (stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ z ∈ K) ∧ statePrefix t r g = h then
                (mu g).toReal * (policyPathKernel M pi (t + r) g z).toReal * f z
              else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro z _
            by_cases he : (stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ z ∈ K) ∧
                statePrefix t r g = h
            · have he' : stateSurvives K ((t + r) + 1) (g, z) ∧
                  statePrefix t (r + 1) (g, z) = h := he
              rw [if_pos he', if_pos he]
              change (pmfExtend mu (policyPathKernel M pi (t + r)) (g, z)).toReal *
                f z = _
              rw [UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend_apply, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
            · have he' : ¬ (stateSurvives K ((t + r) + 1) (g, z) ∧
                  statePrefix t (r + 1) (g, z) = h) := he
              rw [if_neg he', if_neg he]
          _ = _ := hinner g
      rw [hrec, ih F]
      congr 1
      change (∑ j : K, ((killedMatrix M pi K) ^ r) i j *
          ∑ k : K, killedMatrix M pi K j k * f k.1) =
        ∑ j : K, ((killedMatrix M pi K) ^ (r + 1)) i j * f j.1
      simp only [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      ring

/-- The actual state-law atom on a safe path is its killed product weight.
The PMF recursion supplies every factor; the equality is not an assumption. -/
theorem state_safe_atom_eq_matrixPathWeight :
    ∀ n (h : CausalHistory K K n),
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) n (safeHistory K n h)).toReal =
        matrixPathWeight (safeInitialRow p0 K) (killedMatrix M pi K) n h := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro h
      change (pmfExtend (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) n)
        (policyPathKernel M pi n) (safeHistory K n h.1, h.2.1)).toReal = _
      rw [UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend_apply, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ih h.1]
      simp only [matrixPathWeight, policyPathKernel, policyTransitionPMF_apply_toReal,
        safeHistory_current, killedMatrix, policyMatrix]

/-- Joint mass of a fixed safe prefix and survival through t+r. -/
theorem state_prefix_survival_mass
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (hs : stateSurvives K t h) (i : K) (hi : currentState t h = i.1) :
    (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) (t + r)).toMeasure.real
      {g | stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ statePrefix t r g = h} =
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal *
        remainingSurvival (killedMatrix M pi K) r i := by
  rw [finite_event_mass]
  calc
    _ = weightedPrefixMass M pi p0 K t r h (fun _ => 1) := by
      unfold weightedPrefixMass
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro g _
      by_cases he : stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ statePrefix t r g = h
      · simp only [he, mul_one]
      · simp only [he, if_false]
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [mul_one, remainingSurvival] using
        weightedPrefixMass_eq M pi p0 K t r h hs i hi (fun _ => 1)

end StateSource

/-- Positive remaining-survival row, with r further steps after this transition. -/
def finiteWindowRow {S : Type u} [Fintype S]
    (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) (r : ℕ) (i j : S) : ℝ :=
  Q i j * remainingSurvival Q r j / remainingSurvival Q (r + 1) i

/-- Only a positive row is normalized; no total-row claim is made at zero mass. -/
def finiteWindowRowPMF
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j) (r : ℕ) (i : S)
    (hpos : 0 < remainingSurvival Q (r + 1) i) : PMF S :=
  FiniteProbabilityRow.ofRealRow (finiteWindowRow Q r i)
    (fun j => div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (hQ i j) (remainingSurvival_nonneg Q hQ r j)) hpos.le)
    (by
      simp only [finiteWindowRow, ← Finset.sum_div, ← remainingSurvival_succ]
      exact div_self hpos.ne')

@[simp] theorem finiteWindowRowPMF_apply_toReal
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j) (r : ℕ) (i : S)
    (hpos : 0 < remainingSurvival Q (r + 1) i) (j : S) :
    (finiteWindowRowPMF Q hQ r i hpos j).toReal = finiteWindowRow Q r i j := by
  unfold finiteWindowRowPMF
  exact FiniteProbabilityRow.ofRealRow_apply_toReal (finiteWindowRow Q r i) _ _ j

section ActualSource

variable {X Y A : Type u} [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
variable [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
variable [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSingletonClass A]
variable (M : Model X (fun _ => A)) (q : X → Y) (sigma : Y → PMF A)
variable (p0 : PMF X) (K : Set X)

local notation "pi" => liftedStationaryPolicy q sigma
local notation "Q" => killedMatrix M pi K

/-- Actual survival probability in the original action/state experiment. -/
def actualSurvivalMass (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (causalLaw p0 (riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
    (observationMarkovPolicy sigma)) n).toMeasure.real
      {g | ¬ riskEverFailure (fun x => x ∉ K) n g}

/-- The actual complete state prefix and the original final survival event. -/
def actualPrefixSurvivalMass (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t) : ℝ :=
  (causalLaw p0 (riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
    (observationMarkovPolicy sigma)) (t + r)).toMeasure.real
      {g | ¬ riskEverFailure (fun x => x ∉ K) (t + r) g ∧
        statePrefix t r (eraseActionHistory (t + r) g) = h}

/-- The source identity is proved from action erasure and the actual suffix sum. -/
theorem actual_prefix_survival_mass
    (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (hs : stateSurvives K t h) (i : K) (hi : currentState t h = i.1) :
    actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K t r h =
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal *
        remainingSurvival Q r i := by
  let nu := causalLaw p0 (riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
    (observationMarkovPolicy sigma)) (t + r)
  let E : Set (CausalHistory X X (t + r)) :=
    {g | stateSurvives K (t + r) g ∧ statePrefix t r g = h}
  have hevent : (eraseActionHistory (X := X) (A := A) (t + r)) ⁻¹' E =
      {g | ¬ riskEverFailure (fun x => x ∉ K) (t + r) g ∧
        statePrefix t r (eraseActionHistory (t + r) g) = h} := by
    ext g
    simp only [E, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, stateSurvives_erase_iff]
  have hm := PMF.toMeasure_map_apply (eraseActionHistory (X := X) (A := A) (t + r))
    nu E (measurable_of_finite _) (Set.toFinite E).measurableSet
  calc
    actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K t r h =
        (nu.map (eraseActionHistory (t + r))).toMeasure.real E := by
      simpa only [actualPrefixSurvivalMass, nu, Measure.real, hevent] using
        (congrArg ENNReal.toReal hm).symm
    _ = (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) (t + r)).toMeasure.real E := by
      rw [actual_state_path_eq_stationary_path M q sigma p0 (t + r)]
    _ = _ := state_prefix_survival_mass M pi p0 K t r h hs i hi

private theorem filter_map_atom_real
    {H Z : Type u} [Fintype H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [MeasurableSingletonClass H]
    (p : PMF H) (S : Set H) (hs : ∃ h ∈ S, h ∈ p.support)
    (f : H → Z) (z : Z) :
    (((p.filter S hs).map f) z).toReal =
      p.toMeasure.real {h | h ∈ S ∧ f h = z} / p.toMeasure.real S := by
  have he : ((p.filter S hs).map f) z =
      p.toMeasure {h | h ∈ S ∧ f h = z} / p.toMeasure S := by
    rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype]
    simp only [PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype, div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    rw [PMF.filter_apply, tsum_fintype]
    by_cases hS : h ∈ S
    · by_cases hz : f h = z
      · subst z
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hS]
      · have hz' : z ≠ f h := Ne.symm hz
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hS, hz, hz']
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hS]
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_div, Measure.real] using congrArg ENNReal.toReal he

/-- Filter the original complete experiment at t+r, then retain its state prefix. -/
def actualConditionedPrefix (t r : ℕ)
    (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + r)) :
    PMF (CausalHistory X X t) :=
  ((causalLaw p0 (riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
    (observationMarkovPolicy sigma)) (t + r)).filter
      {g | ¬ riskEverFailure (fun x => x ∉ K) (t + r) g}
      ((actual_survival_pos_iff_support M q sigma p0 K (t + r)).1 hpos)).map
    (fun g => statePrefix t r (eraseActionHistory (t + r) g))

/-- Filtering the actual final-survival event leaves only safe retained prefixes. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_prefix_support
    (t r : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + r)) :
    (actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K t r hpos).support ⊆
      {h | stateSurvives K t h} := by
  intro h hh
  unfold actualConditionedPrefix at hh
  rcases (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).1 hh with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  have hsafe := (PMF.mem_support_filter_iff
    ((actual_survival_pos_iff_support M q sigma p0 K (t + r)).1 hpos)).1 hg
  exact stateSurvives_prefix K t r _
    ((stateSurvives_erase_iff K (t + r) g).2 hsafe.1)

/-- Unsafe prefix atoms vanish in the actual conditioned PMF, including
complete-window atoms outside the safe history subtype. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_prefix_eq_zero_of_not_survives
    (t r : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + r))
    (h : CausalHistory X X t) (hunsafe : ¬ stateSurvives K t h) :
    actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K t r hpos h = 0 := by
  apply (PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ h).2
  intro hh
  exact hunsafe (actual_conditioned_prefix_support M q sigma p0 K t r hpos hh)

/-- Every conditional prefix atom is calculated in the same filtered experiment. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_prefix_mass
    (t r : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + r))
    (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (hs : stateSurvives K t h) (i : K) (hi : currentState t h = i.1) :
    (actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K t r hpos h).toReal =
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal *
        remainingSurvival Q r i / actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + r) := by
  unfold actualConditionedPrefix
  rw [filter_map_atom_real]
  change actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K t r h /
    actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + r) = _
  rw [actual_prefix_survival_mass M q sigma p0 K t r h hs i hi]

/-- Future survival changes the initial law by the actual remaining-survival weight.
At T=0 this retains and normalizes the original safe initial mass. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_initial_mass
    (T : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (0 + T)) (i : K) :
    (actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K 0 T hpos i.1).toReal =
      safeInitialRow p0 K i * remainingSurvival Q T i /
        actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K T := by
  rw [actual_conditioned_prefix_mass M q sigma p0 K 0 T hpos i.1 i.property i rfl]
  change (p0 i.1).toReal * remainingSurvival Q T i /
      actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (0 + T) =
    (p0 i.1).toReal * remainingSurvival Q T i /
      actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K T
  rw [Nat.zero_add]

/-- The complete conditional safe path has the actual killed product weight. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_safe_path_mass
    (T : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (T + 0))
    (h : CausalHistory K K T) :
    (actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K T 0 hpos (safeHistory K T h)).toReal =
      matrixPathWeight (safeInitialRow p0 K) Q T h /
        actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K T := by
  rw [actual_conditioned_prefix_mass M q sigma p0 K T 0 hpos
    (safeHistory K T h) (safeHistory_survives K T h) (currentState T h)
    (safeHistory_current K T h)]
  rw [remainingSurvival_zero, mul_one, state_safe_atom_eq_matrixPathWeight, Nat.add_zero]

/-- A positive actual prefix-survival event forces the relevant row denominator
to be positive. Global positive survival alone is not used for this conclusion. -/
theorem actual_positive_prefix_remaining_pos
    (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (hs : stateSurvives K t h) (i : K) (hi : currentState t h = i.1)
    (hpos : 0 < actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K t r h) :
    0 < remainingSurvival Q r i := by
  rw [actual_prefix_survival_mass M q sigma p0 K t r h hs i hi] at hpos
  have hp : 0 ≤ (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  by_contra hn
  have hnonpos := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hp (le_of_not_gt hn)
  linarith

/-- The ratio of actual child and parent events is the finite-window row.
The two event horizons (t+1)+r and t+(r+1) are the same natural number.
The positive parent premise excludes exactly the undefined conditional rows. -/
theorem actual_next_prefix_ratio
    (t r : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X t)
    (hs : stateSurvives K t h) (i j : K) (hi : currentState t h = i.1)
    (hpos : 0 < actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K t (r + 1) h) :
    actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (t + 1) r (h, j.1) /
        actualPrefixSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K t (r + 1) h =
      finiteWindowRow Q r i j := by
  have hparent := actual_prefix_survival_mass M q sigma p0 K t (r + 1) h hs i hi
  have hchild := actual_prefix_survival_mass M q sigma p0 K (t + 1) r
    (h, j.1) ⟨hs, j.property⟩ j rfl
  have hg := actual_positive_prefix_remaining_pos M q sigma p0 K t (r + 1)
    h hs i hi hpos
  have hp : 0 < (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal := by
    rw [hparent] at hpos
    by_contra hn
    have hnonpos := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hn) hg.le
    linarith
  have hstep :
      (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) (t + 1) (h, j.1)).toReal =
        (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t h).toReal * Q i j := by
    change (pmfExtend (causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M pi) t)
      (policyPathKernel M pi t) (h, j.1)).toReal = _
    rw [UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend_apply, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
    simp only [policyPathKernel, policyTransitionPMF_apply_toReal, hi,
      killedMatrix, policyMatrix]
  rw [hchild, hparent, hstep]
  unfold finiteWindowRow
  field_simp [hp.ne', hg.ne']

end ActualSource
end
end UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck

import UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindow
import UEOT.V3.Compression.PositiveEigenstructure

/-!
# What the same-source Doob path represents

The existing positive-right-eigenstructure supplies stochastic rows. This file
constructs their actual finite PMF path, proves the telescoping endpoint tilt,
and compares it with the actual survival-conditioned source path. A left QSD
is not used as a substitute for a complete conditioned path identity.
-/

namespace UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteWindowDoobCheck

open MeasureTheory
open UEOT.V3.PathError
open UEOT.V3.FiniteDiscountedControl
open UEOT.V3.CoreOperationalAssembly
open UEOT.V3.QSDPerron
open UEOT.V3.Compression.PositiveEigenstructure
  (RightEigenData hTransform hTransform_nonneg hTransform_row_sum)
open SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck SameSourceKilledPathCheck
open SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck
open scoped BigOperators Classical

noncomputable section
universe u

/-- Pairing with the actual unnormalized initial row. It is not assumed to be one. -/
def initialPairing {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (eta h : S → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : S, eta i * h i

/-- Actual PMF row of the existing positive-eigenstructure Doob transform. -/
def doobRowPMF {S : Type u} [Fintype S]
    {Q : Matrix S S ℝ} (D : RightEigenData Q)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j) (i : S) : PMF S :=
  FiniteProbabilityRow.ofRealRow (hTransform D i)
    (hTransform_nonneg D hQ i) (hTransform_row_sum D i)

@[simp] theorem doobRowPMF_apply_toReal
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] {Q : Matrix S S ℝ}
    (D : RightEigenData Q) (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j) (i j : S) :
    (doobRowPMF D hQ i j).toReal = hTransform D i j := by
  unfold doobRowPMF
  exact FiniteProbabilityRow.ofRealRow_apply_toReal (hTransform D i) _ _ j

/-- Natural initial h-tilt, normalized by its own actual pairing. -/
def tiltedInitialPMF {S : Type u} [Fintype S]
    {Q : Matrix S S ℝ} (D : RightEigenData Q)
    (eta : S → ℝ) (heta : ∀ i, 0 ≤ eta i)
    (hc : 0 < initialPairing eta D.vector) : PMF S :=
  FiniteProbabilityRow.ofRealRow
    (fun i => eta i * D.vector i / initialPairing eta D.vector)
    (fun i => div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (heta i) (D.vector_pos i).le) hc.le)
    (by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      exact div_self hc.ne')

@[simp] theorem tiltedInitialPMF_apply_toReal
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] {Q : Matrix S S ℝ}
    (D : RightEigenData Q) (eta : S → ℝ) (heta : ∀ i, 0 ≤ eta i)
    (hc : 0 < initialPairing eta D.vector) (i : S) :
    (tiltedInitialPMF D eta heta hc i).toReal =
      eta i * D.vector i / initialPairing eta D.vector := by
  unfold tiltedInitialPMF
  exact FiniteProbabilityRow.ofRealRow_apply_toReal
    (fun j => eta j * D.vector j / initialPairing eta D.vector) _ _ i

/-- The genuine finite PMF path generated by the tilted initial law and
the same matrix's stationary Doob rows. -/
def doobPathLaw {S : Type u} [Fintype S] {Q : Matrix S S ℝ}
    (D : RightEigenData Q) (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j)
    (eta : S → ℝ) (heta : ∀ i, 0 ≤ eta i)
    (hc : 0 < initialPairing eta D.vector) (T : ℕ) :
    PMF (CausalHistory S S T) :=
  causalLaw (tiltedInitialPMF D eta heta hc)
    (fun n g => doobRowPMF D hQ (currentState n g)) T

/-- The Doob path is the original killed weight tilted at the final state.
The proof expands the actual PMF recursion and cancels interior h factors. -/
theorem doob_path_atom
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] {Q : Matrix S S ℝ}
    (D : RightEigenData Q) (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j)
    (eta : S → ℝ) (heta : ∀ i, 0 ≤ eta i)
    (hc : 0 < initialPairing eta D.vector) :
    ∀ T (g : CausalHistory S S T),
      (doobPathLaw D hQ eta heta hc T g).toReal =
        matrixPathWeight eta Q T g * D.vector (currentState T g) /
          (D.scale ^ T * initialPairing eta D.vector) := by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero =>
      intro g
      simp only [doobPathLaw, causalLaw, tiltedInitialPMF_apply_toReal,
        matrixPathWeight, currentState, pow_zero, one_mul]
  | succ T ih =>
      intro g
      rcases g with ⟨g, j⟩
      change (pmfExtend (doobPathLaw D hQ eta heta hc T)
        (fun p => doobRowPMF D hQ (currentState T p)) (g, j)).toReal = _
      rw [UEOT.V3.PathError.pmfExtend_apply, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ih g,
        doobRowPMF_apply_toReal]
      simp only [matrixPathWeight, currentState, hTransform, pow_succ]
      have hr : D.scale ≠ 0 := D.scale_pos.ne'
      have hh : D.vector (currentState T g) ≠ 0 := (D.vector_pos _).ne'
      have hn : D.scale ^ T ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hr
      field_simp [hr, hh, hn, hc.ne']
      <;> ring

/-- A constant one-step survival rate forces every remaining-survival function
to be the corresponding power. This is a sufficient condition, not a general
consequence of a left QSD. -/
theorem remainingSurvival_eq_pow_of_constant_row_sum
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j : S, Q i j = rho) :
    ∀ r i, remainingSurvival Q r i = rho ^ r := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero => intro i; simp
  | succ r ih =>
      intro i
      rw [remainingSurvival_succ]
      simp_rw [ih]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow i, pow_succ]
      ring

/-- Under constant positive row sum, each positive finite-window row is Q/rho. -/
theorem finiteWindowRow_eq_normalized_of_constant_row_sum
    {S : Type u} [Fintype S] (Q : Matrix S S ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j : S, Q i j = rho)
    (r : ℕ) (i j : S) :
    finiteWindowRow Q r i j = Q i j / rho := by
  unfold finiteWindowRow
  rw [remainingSurvival_eq_pow_of_constant_row_sum Q rho hrow r j,
    remainingSurvival_eq_pow_of_constant_row_sum Q rho hrow (r + 1) i,
    pow_succ]
  field_simp [hrho.ne', pow_ne_zero r hrho.ne']
  <;> ring

section ActualSource

variable {X Y A : Type u} [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
variable [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
variable [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSingletonClass A]
variable (M : Model X (fun _ => A)) (q : X → Y) (sigma : Y → PMF A)
variable (p0 : PMF X) (K : Set X)

local notation "pi" => liftedStationaryPolicy q sigma
local notation "Q" => killedMatrix M pi K
local notation "eta" => safeInitialRow p0 K

/-- The two existing killed-row and new remaining-survival expressions have
the same actual total mass. Initial unsafe mass remains excluded, not renormalized. -/
theorem actual_survival_mass_eq_initial_remaining_sum (T : ℕ) :
    actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K T =
      ∑ i : K, eta i * remainingSurvival Q T i := by
  unfold actualSurvivalMass
  rw [actual_survival_mass_eq_killed_pow_sum]
  simp only [UEOT.V3.QSDPerron.rowApply, remainingSurvival]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

/-- The actual Doob path and the actual finite-window conditioned path differ
by the final h-tilt. Both use exactly the original initial row and killed matrix. -/
theorem actual_doob_path_comparison
    (D : RightEigenData Q)
    (hc : 0 < initialPairing eta D.vector)
    (T : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (T + 0))
    (g : CausalHistory K K T) :
    (doobPathLaw D (killedMatrix_nonneg M pi K) eta
      (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) hc T g).toReal =
      (actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K T 0 hpos
        (safeHistory K T g)).toReal *
      (actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K T * D.vector (currentState T g) /
        (D.scale ^ T * initialPairing eta D.vector)) := by
  rw [doob_path_atom, actual_conditioned_safe_path_mass]
  have hr : D.scale ^ T ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ D.scale_pos.ne'
  field_simp [hpos.ne', hr, hc.ne']
  <;> ring

/-- On each positive killed path, equality with the natural Doob path is exactly
constancy of the terminal h weight at rho^T <eta,h> / s_T. This criterion is
restricted to the actual positive path, not imposed on unreachable states. -/
theorem actual_doob_atom_eq_iff_terminal_weight
    (D : RightEigenData Q)
    (hc : 0 < initialPairing eta D.vector)
    (T : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K (T + 0))
    (g : CausalHistory K K T)
    (hg : 0 < matrixPathWeight eta Q T g) :
    (doobPathLaw D (killedMatrix_nonneg M pi K) eta
      (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) hc T g).toReal =
        (actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0 K T 0 hpos
          (safeHistory K T g)).toReal ↔
      D.vector (currentState T g) =
        D.scale ^ T * initialPairing eta D.vector /
          actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K T := by
  rw [doob_path_atom, actual_conditioned_safe_path_mass]
  have hd : D.scale ^ T * initialPairing eta D.vector ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ D.scale_pos.ne') hc.ne'
  rw [div_eq_div_iff hd hpos.ne', eq_div_iff hpos.ne']
  constructor
  · intro heq
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hg.ne'
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using heq
  · intro heq
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun z => matrixPathWeight eta Q T g * z) heq

end ActualSource
end
end UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteWindowDoobCheck

import UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteWindowDoob
import UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceQSDBinding

/-!
# A three-state source separates finite-window conditioning from fixed Doob paths

The original controlled model has two safe states and one absorbing cemetery.
Its actual killed matrix, original initial law, QSD relation and positive right
vector all feed the same-source path APIs. Exact rational arithmetic gives
TV = 1/4 at horizon one, despite the genuine left QSD.
-/

namespace UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteWindowDoobWitnessCheck

open MeasureTheory UEOT.V3.PathError UEOT.V3.TotalVariation
open UEOT.V3.FiniteDiscountedControl UEOT.V3.CoreOperationalAssembly
open UEOT.V3.QSDPerron
open SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck SameSourceKilledPathCheck
open SameSourceConditionedTerminalCheck SameSourceQSDBindingCheck
open SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck FiniteWindowDoobCheck
open UEOT.V3.Compression.PositiveEigenstructure (RightEigenData colApply)
open scoped BigOperators Classical

noncomputable section

abbrev State := Option Bool
local instance : MeasurableSpace State := ⊤
local instance : MeasurableSpace Unit := ⊤

/-- `none` is the cemetery; `some false` and `some true` are the safe states. -/
def safe : Set State := {x | x ≠ none}

def safeEquiv : Bool ≃ safe where
  toFun b := ⟨some b, by simp [safe]⟩
  invFun v := match v with
    | ⟨none, h⟩ => False.elim (h rfl)
    | ⟨some b, _⟩ => b
  left_inv b := rfl
  right_inv v := by
    rcases v with ⟨_ | b, h⟩
    · exact False.elim (h rfl)
    · rfl

private theorem sum_safe (f : safe → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : safe, f v) = f (safeEquiv false) + f (safeEquiv true) := by
  simpa [Fintype.sum_bool, add_comm] using (safeEquiv.sum_comp f).symm

/-- A complete stochastic matrix on the original three states. -/
def transition : State → Unit → State → ℝ
  | none, _, none => 1
  | none, _, some _ => 0
  | some false, _, none => 1 / 4
  | some false, _, some _ => 3 / 8
  | some true, _, none => 3 / 4
  | some true, _, some _ => 1 / 8

def model : Model State (fun _ => Unit) where
  transition := transition
  reward := fun _ _ => 0
  rewardBound := 1
  discount := 1 / 2
  transition_nonneg := by
    intro x a y
    fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y <;> norm_num [transition]
  transition_sum_one := by
    intro x a
    fin_cases x <;> norm_num [transition, Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.sum_bool]
  reward_abs_le := by intros; norm_num
  discount_pos := by norm_num
  discount_lt_one := by norm_num

def observe (_ : State) : Unit := ()
def feedback (_ : Unit) : PMF Unit := PMF.pure ()
def safeLaw : PMF safe := (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).map safeEquiv
/-- The original initial PMF, with no cemetery mass. -/
def initial : PMF State := safeLaw.map Subtype.val
/-- This is the restriction of the actual feedback-induced model matrix. -/
def killed : Matrix safe safe ℝ :=
  killedMatrix model (liftedStationaryPolicy observe feedback) safe

@[simp] theorem safeLaw_mass (b : Bool) :
    (safeLaw (safeEquiv b)).toReal = 1 / 2 := by
  unfold safeLaw
  rw [pmf_map_injective_atom safeEquiv safeEquiv.injective]
  norm_num [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply]

@[simp] theorem initial_safe_mass (b : Bool) :
    safeInitialRow initial safe (safeEquiv b) = 1 / 2 := by
  change safeInitialRow (safeLaw.map Subtype.val) safe (safeEquiv b) = _
  rw [safeInitialRow_map_subtype]
  exact safeLaw_mass b

@[simp] theorem killed_entry (i j : Bool) :
    killed (safeEquiv i) (safeEquiv j) = if i then 1 / 8 else 3 / 8 := by
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    norm_num [killed, killedMatrix, policyMatrix, Model.policyTransition,
      liftedStationaryPolicy, observe, feedback, model, transition, safeEquiv]

/-- The uniform safe law really is a left QSD of this source, with rho = 1/2. -/
theorem source_left_qsd (j : safe) :
    rowApply (fun i => (safeLaw i).toReal) killed j = (1 / 2) * (safeLaw j).toReal := by
  rcases safeEquiv.surjective j with ⟨b, rfl⟩
  unfold rowApply
  rw [sum_safe]
  simp only [safeLaw_mass, killed_entry]
  norm_num

/-- Actual original survival, inherited from the same-source QSD identity. -/
theorem actual_survival (T : ℕ) :
    actualSurvivalMass model observe feedback initial safe T = (1 / 2) ^ T := by
  exact actual_qsd_survival_mass model observe feedback safe safeLaw (1 / 2)
    source_left_qsd T

private theorem actual_survival_one_pos :
    0 < actualSurvivalMass model observe feedback initial safe (1 + 0) := by
  rw [actual_survival]
  norm_num

/-- Right data normalized so that the actual initial pairing is one. -/
def rightVector (i : safe) : ℝ := if safeEquiv.symm i then 1 / 2 else 3 / 2

def rightData : RightEigenData killed where
  scale := 1 / 2
  vector := rightVector
  scale_pos := by norm_num
  vector_pos := by
    intro i
    rcases safeEquiv.surjective i with ⟨b, rfl⟩
    cases b <;> norm_num [rightVector, safeEquiv]
  eigen := by
    intro i
    rcases safeEquiv.surjective i with ⟨b, rfl⟩
    unfold colApply
    rw [sum_safe]
    cases b <;> norm_num [killed_entry, rightVector, safeEquiv]

@[simp] theorem actual_initial_pairing :
    initialPairing (safeInitialRow initial safe) rightData.vector = 1 := by
  unfold initialPairing
  rw [sum_safe]
  norm_num [initial_safe_mass, rightData, rightVector, safeEquiv]

private theorem initial_pairing_pos :
    0 < initialPairing (safeInitialRow initial safe) rightData.vector := by
  rw [actual_initial_pairing]
  norm_num

/-- The real original path law conditioned on survival through time one. -/
def conditionedPair : PMF (State × State) :=
  actualConditionedPrefix model observe feedback initial safe 1 0 actual_survival_one_pos

/-- The actual Doob PMF path uses this same killed matrix and original initial row. -/
def safeDoobPair : PMF (safe × safe) :=
  doobPathLaw rightData
    (killedMatrix_nonneg model (liftedStationaryPolicy observe feedback) safe)
    (safeInitialRow initial safe) (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    initial_pairing_pos 1

def embedPair (h : safe × safe) : State × State := (h.1.val, h.2.val)
def doobPair : PMF (State × State) := safeDoobPair.map embedPair

private theorem embedPair_injective : Function.Injective embedPair := by
  intro h g heq
  exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst heq))
    (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd heq))

/-- Conditional pair rows are (3/8,3/8) and (1/8,1/8). -/
theorem conditioned_safe_atom (i j : Bool) :
    (conditionedPair (some i, some j)).toReal = if i then 1 / 8 else 3 / 8 := by
  have h := actual_conditioned_safe_path_mass model observe feedback initial safe
    1 actual_survival_one_pos (safeEquiv i, safeEquiv j)
  change (conditionedPair (some i, some j)).toReal = _ at h
  rw [actual_survival] at h
  simpa [matrixPathWeight, currentState, initial_safe_mass, killed_entry,
    killed, safeEquiv] using h

/-- Doob pair rows are (9/16,3/16) and (3/16,1/16). -/
theorem doob_safe_atom (i j : Bool) :
    (doobPair (some i, some j)).toReal =
      (if i then 1 / 4 else 3 / 4) * (if j then 1 / 4 else 3 / 4) := by
  change ((safeDoobPair.map embedPair) (embedPair (safeEquiv i, safeEquiv j))).toReal = _
  rw [pmf_map_injective_atom embedPair embedPair_injective]
  unfold safeDoobPair
  rw [doob_path_atom]
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    norm_num [matrixPathWeight, currentState, initial_safe_mass, killed_entry,
      actual_initial_pairing, rightData, rightVector, safeEquiv]

@[simp] theorem doob_cemetery_left (y : State) : doobPair (none, y) = 0 := by
  unfold doobPair
  rw [PMF.map_apply]
  apply tsum_eq_zero
  intro h
  apply if_neg
  intro heq
  exact h.1.property (congrArg Prod.fst heq)

@[simp] theorem doob_cemetery_right (x : State) : doobPair (x, none) = 0 := by
  unfold doobPair
  rw [PMF.map_apply]
  apply tsum_eq_zero
  intro h
  apply if_neg
  intro heq
  exact h.2.property (congrArg Prod.snd heq)

@[simp] theorem conditioned_cemetery_left (y : State) : conditionedPair (none, y) = 0 := by
  apply actual_conditioned_prefix_eq_zero_of_not_survives model observe feedback initial
    safe 1 0 actual_survival_one_pos (none, y)
  simp [stateSurvives, safe]

@[simp] theorem conditioned_cemetery_right (x : State) : conditionedPair (x, none) = 0 := by
  apply actual_conditioned_prefix_eq_zero_of_not_survives model observe feedback initial
    safe 1 0 actual_survival_one_pos (x, none)
  simp [stateSurvives, safe]

/-- A genuine left QSD does not identify the complete finite-window conditional
path with the stationary Doob path, even with its natural tilted initial law. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_doob_tv :
    tvDist conditionedPair.toMeasure doobPair.toMeasure = 1 / 4 := by
  rw [tvDist_eq_one_sub_pmfCommonMass]
  simp only [pmfCommonMass, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option,
    Fintype.sum_bool, conditioned_cemetery_left, conditioned_cemetery_right,
    doob_cemetery_left, doob_cemetery_right, conditioned_safe_atom, doob_safe_atom]
  norm_num

/-- Nonidentity is witnessed in the original three-state experiment. -/
theorem actual_conditioned_ne_doob : conditionedPair ≠ doobPair := by
  intro h
  have htv := actual_conditioned_doob_tv
  rw [h, tvDist_self_eq_zero] at htv
  norm_num at htv

end
